//: Story Phase 15: Brogath's ancient crew, as lore records (the pocket edition, the Stenchmaster Channel, Brogath's own stories). Nobody here is reincarnated: reincarnationAllowed is false for all of them (the validator insists), and the cardboard plan of chapter 172 is prevented. futurePortraitAsset names art a later phase may paint. Story Phase 17: two of them came back. Ledger Billiam and No-Nonsense Tilda were drawn on cardboard by Brogath and an escaped plume of the treasure room's cloud went into them (chapter 208): their records allow it, and name the reincarnation (its flag, the NPC and the party member). Everybody else stays false: Old Jeb, Wobbly Ned and Elsie Beanwright are cut-outs and nothing more (future hooks).

ledger_billiam.summary: Brogath's bookkeeper: a narrow, dry little man with two ledgers, one for money and one for atmospheric wealth, who treated every impossible thing as a bookkeeping problem. Wrote the WILL FART FOR FOOD sign.
knownHistoricalIncidents: Tried to bottle the market value of the wind in a barrel; Brogath spoiled the breeze.
Numbered the ship's corridors starting at forty-one.
Calculated the market value of being raised up a mast.
ledger_billiam.brogathRelationship: Loyal to the last ledger. Recorded every fart Brogath ever did as revenue.

nononsense_tilda.summary: Stern, practical, sensible boots and a sensible (GREEN) hat. Plainly the grounded one. Took part in every catastrophically stupid plan anyway, and navigated by a compass she drew herself.
knownHistoricalIncidents: Steered by a hand-drawn compass; the crew followed it the wrong way; Brogath's accidental fart turned the ship round and she called it navigation.
nononsense_tilda.brogathRelationship: The one who said 'No' first, and came along anyway. Brogath trusted her more than any compass.

old_jeb.summary: Old even then. Rattled when he walked. Sold things, including things that weren't his and things that didn't exist, and nailed up the signs that got the crew lost aboard their own ship.
knownHistoricalIncidents: Put up the conflicting arrows in the Lost Inside Our Own Ship incident.
old_jeb.brogathRelationship: Fixed whatever Brogath broke. Mostly furniture.
old_jeb.//: Story Phase 17: Brogath drew this one too (a dormant cut-out by the quarters' north wall). Not reincarnated: a future hook.

wobbly_ned.summary: Guarded the anchor from anchor thieves (there were none) so devotedly that nobody could ever use the anchor.
knownHistoricalIncidents: The Anchor Watch: three weeks unable to anchor anywhere.
wobbly_ned.brogathRelationship: Brogath gave him the job. Brogath couldn't take it back.
wobbly_ned.//: Story Phase 17: Brogath drew this one too (a dormant cut-out by the quarters' north wall). Not reincarnated: a future hook.

blindeye_margery.summary: The lookout, with a patch over one eye and a habit of turning the telescope round. Saw everything, eventually, very small.
knownHistoricalIncidents: Took down the one sign that might have helped, in the Lost Inside Our Own Ship incident.
blindeye_margery.brogathRelationship: Always said she'd seen it coming. Never saw anything coming.

halfmast_harold.summary: Told to raise the main, raised everything: the sail, the flag, the lantern, the hatch, and Ledger Billiam.
knownHistoricalIncidents: Raised Ledger Billiam halfway up the mainmast; Ledger calculated the market value of being elevated.
halfmast_harold.brogathRelationship: Did exactly what he was told. That was the problem.

sometimes_clem.summary: Captain whenever Brogath didn't want to be, which was often, and vice versa. Neither of them would ever give an order first.
knownHistoricalIncidents: Both deferred, both collided, both apologised, and between them steered the ship clean out of a reef.
sometimes_clem.brogathRelationship: Each thought the other was in charge. Together, accidentally, they were.

elsie_beanwright.summary: The cook. Believed nearly every problem required beans. Her breakfasts are the source of the legend of the Morning of Many Winds.
knownHistoricalIncidents: The Morning of Many Winds: one breakfast, the whole crew, and a harbour that has never been the same.
elsie_beanwright.brogathRelationship: Fed Brogath every day of his life. The captain is particularly adamant she must never, ever be reincarnated anywhere near Garrick.
elsie_beanwright.//: Story Phase 17: Brogath drew this one too (a dormant cut-out by the quarters' north wall). Not reincarnated: a future hook.
